subject.note: runsAt merges origin/main at ce322e1a, whose only change near this subject is launched.test.ts (syzygy-bpyt.8.24); that file is left out of files and diffSha256

rerun: From the tree root, with empty directories /tmp/la-b82/g, /tmp/la-b82/gcwd and /tmp/la-b82/home: the goldens fix those paths so that every message naming one is byte-comparable between runs. A mutant spec runs as mutate.py <tree> <spec> <log> with EVIDENCE set to this directory and OUT to an empty one holding oracle/ from extract_parsers.py <tree> $OUT/oracle.

negativeControl.what: argv.ts reading a valued option by its token name, so `--name=value` is taken

readerMutants.what: one mutant per predicate of readArgv, each rerunning the dossier and parse goldens; a mutant is killed when a golden differs

finding.disposition: survived: the raw-name clause it mutated was redundant, since every later branch compares the whole argument with the literal names; c5908cc0 removed the clause, and R2b mutates the property where it now lives

readerMutants.typeOnly: the `token.kind === 'option'` conjunct narrows the token's type for its value; the only other token kind that reaches it is `--`, which is no valued name, so no mutant of it can change a result
